Anakinra is an IL-1 receptor antagonist that also reduces inflammation and is used in rheumatoid arthritis. analysis: The question asks which drug obtained by molecular engineering is not applicable in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis. Infliximab, Adalimumab, and Etanercept are TNF-alpha inhibitors, and Anakinra is an IL-1 receptor antagonist; all are used in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis to reduce inflammation. Denosumab, on the other hand, is a RANKL inhibitor used primarily for conditions like osteoporosis to reduce bone resorption and is not typically used for rheumatoid arthritis. Therefore, based on standard medical knowledge and consensus, Denosumab is the drug that is not applicable in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis.
